Why a queue, and what if I miss a place?

A QR code opens a record. Authentication requires examination of the physical card; verification also requires comparing that card and its holder with the correct recorded details. A copied code alone cannot establish authenticity.

When does the clock start and finish?
The grading clock starts at official LORE check-in. Saving cards, joining the Sunday Queue and mailing a package do not start it. Official check-in must be confirmed separately from carrier delivery.

The completion commitment covers grading, encapsulation and final quality control. Carrier transit is separate. Check-in cutoffs, the holiday calendar and dispatch arrangements will be published before paid submissions open.
What happens if LORE misses the deadline?

Your applicable grading fee is refunded, and your eligible card is still graded, encapsulated and returned. The refund does not buy a higher grade. Cards with unresolved authenticity or alteration concerns do not receive a numerical grade simply to meet a deadline.

The refund applies to the grading fee. Handling, shipping, tax treatment and optional services are separately disclosed. Refund processing timing and any narrowly defined exceptions will be published before paid submissions open; this preview does not process payments or refunds.
Can my grade or card value increase the grading fee?

No. LORE does not add a value-based or grade-based upcharge to the agreed grading fee. A higher grade does not trigger a higher grading bill. Any optional service or applicable extra is itemized and agreed before submission.
Does the public queue add waiting time?

The Sunday Queue controls accepted capacity before cards are shipped. Staging a card is not acceptance. Collectors keep their cards until an intake place is confirmed; the 14-business-day grading clock starts at official check-in after acceptance.

LORE is dedicated to trading-card game collectors. Sports cards are outside our grading scope. Exact card eligibility is confirmed during intake; catalog inclusion alone does not confirm authenticity or eligibility.
How will my card be assessed?

The planned process combines AI-assisted analysis with two independent human graders examining centering, corners, edges and surface. Human graders record their assessments without seeing the AI score or each other’s assessment. Any grading disagreement receives head-grader review, followed by verification and final quality control.
What are the grading prices and turnaround times?

Standard: $50 per card and 14 business days. Express: $125 per card and 5 business days. Eligible Gold Founders: $75 per card and 2-4 business days, with the Founder rate available for three years from activation. Prices are USD; shipping, handling, coverage and applicable tax are additional.
When does the turnaround clock start?

The clock starts at official LORE check-in in Orlando, not when you prepare a draft, join the queue or mail your cards. The commitment covers grading, encapsulation and final quality control. Carrier transit is separate.
What happens if LORE misses the deadline?
The applicable grading fee for an eligible late card is refunded, and the card is still graded, encapsulated and returned. Founder service is guaranteed by the end of business day 4.
Does a higher grade increase the grading fee?
No. There are no value-based or grade-based grading upcharges. Any optional services and applicable additional charges are disclosed separately before payment.
What does Gold Founders membership offer?

One membership provides access to the realm lounges, reserved Founder grading capacity, the eligible $75 Founder grading rate for three years, planned 2-4-business-day service, and ten exclusive Founders labels. There are 500 lifetime memberships across LORE. Membership starts at $2,595 USD; future releases may have different pricing.

Must I buy the $1,000 inaugural grading allocation?

No. The inaugural allocation of ten eligible cards at $100 each is optional and separate from membership. You do not have to purchase it to join. Regular eligible Founder grading is $75 per card under the service terms.
No. Every card earns its grade through assessment. The same grading standards apply to every collector and service tier.
Do Founders still join the public Sunday queue?

Founders use separately reserved capacity instead of competing in the public queue. Intake must still be scheduled and remain within the confirmed allowance; membership is not unlimited grading access.
What is the difference between sequential and certification numbers?
Sequential numbering starts at 00001 for each exact card variation and grade. Certification identification is separate and identifies the graded-card record.
Can I send my cards now?
LORE is in prelaunch. The public launch target is November 15, 2026. Do not ship cards until your order is accepted and you receive official shipping instructions. A saved draft is preparation only.
How many cards can I prepare?
Prepare 1-10 cards per order at one service level. Select the exact card, set, number, language and finish.
How does the weekly queue work?

The public drop is planned for Sunday at 8 PM Eastern, with 500 cards in the first week. Saving a batch does not reserve a slot. When a slot is allocated and checkout becomes available, the payment window is 15 minutes from when your individual allocation becomes payable, not from the end of the whole queue. No. Shipping, handling and any additional declared-value coverage are quoted separately before payment. You are responsible for inbound shipping. Applicable tax is additional.
